about: Mont-Royal (Town of Mount Royal) is an on-island suburb of Montreal, Quebec, planned as a garden city at the foot of Mount Royal. Tree-lined streets, a distinctive town centre, and proximity to downtown Montreal define its character. It remains a separate municipality within the Montreal agglomeration. About 20,000 people live in Mont-Royal.
